en:
It has an interesting, chewy texture. It's really quite
wonderful!

Chewy? Are you sure? That's funny. I thought it would be
super soft.

Well, it's springy, like I could keep chewing and chewing it
forever. And it has lots of little stringy bits, too. It's
really very nice!

Really? Hmm. You're not making it sound very nice, to
tell the truth.
I'm not? Oh no, I'm sorry!
Ah, here it comes! Komian's matsutake set!
Mmm, what a wonderful aroma!

Yes, Komian uses the freshest of domestic matsutake
mushrooms to prepare this dish.

Now, then. If you would please give it a try, and tell us
what you think.
All right. I'll just give it a little taste.
Well? What do you think?

(Mmm! This is wonderful, too! But what kind of comment
should I make this time?)

It smells so fresh! I feel like it's stirring up my appetite
even more!

Exactly! It's like a visit to the mountains right here in
the restaurant. That's the true charm of Komian.

I've never had such a delicious mushroom before. It's so
tender!

And you really look like you're enjoying it, Haruka-chan!
Still, Komian has one final ace up its sleeve for you, so
make sure you save room!
Really? Another dish? I can't wait to see what it is!

It's like an upscale version of beech mushrooms! It's so
yummy!

Beech mushrooms!? Well, yes, they're both mushrooms, but
I'd say they taste completely different, wouldn't you?
Yes, that's why I say this is like an upscale version! Nothing like everyday beech mushrooms at all!

I see. Well, these are very expensive, premium matsutake,
after all⑬far from ordinary beech mushrooms.

(Oops. I guess that wasn't a very good comparison.
Commenting on food is a lot harder than I thought.)

That aside, Komian has one final ace up its sleeve for you,
so make sure you save room!

I don't think I could ever get enough of this flavor! I can
see myself getting really addicted!

It is wonderful, isn't it? But I'm afraid it isn't often one
gets a chance to eat such premium matsutake as these.

Then I guess it wouldn't be very practical to get addicted,
would it?

Once you've had Komian's matsutake, you won't be
satisfied by any other. I'm afraid I've spoiled you for
life.
Hehe. Yes, I suppose you have.

But that's not all! Komian has one final ace up its sleeve
for you, so make sure you save room!

Here it is, Komian's ace! It's not on the regular menu!
Grilled marbled wagyu, the finest cut of premium Japanese
beef!
Oh, my goodness! It looks absolutely delicious!

It's not normally offered, but I had them make it specially
for you!

It's the ultimate melt-in-your-mouth beef. I think it might
be difficult to put into words just how delicious it is.

But I digress. Go ahead and try this crowning jewel of
today's segment for yourself.
Okay! Wow, I feel so lucky!

(Oh, my goodness! It really is melting in my mouth! But what
should I say?)
Mmm! It's so juicy and savory! It's unbelievably delicious!

Exactly! That's premium marbled wagyu for you! There's
nothing like Japan's finest.

It's just so juicy every time I chew. I'm so glad I'm
getting the chance to try it!
Haha! Just watching you eat is a joy in itself, Haruka-chan!
Hehe! Well, I'm glad! Thank you!
Mmm! It tastes like it would go well with beer.

Hmm? But you're not old enough to drink. You've never had
beer before, have you?

Well, no, but I just thought this was probably the kind of
flavor that would go well with it.

You don't have to try so hard, you know. Just say what you
think from your own experience.
Oh, all right. It's, um, incredibly delicious.
But in what way...? Oh, well. Never mind.
Oh no, I'm sorry!

Mmm! It really does seem to just melt in my mouth! It's like
I don't even have to chew it!

It's so soft! I almost hate to chew it because I don't want
it to be gone!

Yes, this is indeed a food that makes people happy. The word
"delicious" doesn't even begin to do it justice.
Oh, I agree!

Haha! I'd say watching you eat is a joy in itself,
Haruka-chan!

Okay, cut! That's a wrap on the gourmet report segment!
Thank you, you two!

Whew! You really saved me, Haruka-chan. You have my deepest
thanks.
I was happy to do it. How are you feeling now?

A little better, thanks. But I think if I'd tried to eat
anything, it would've been bad news.

You did a great job with the report! Amazing for someone
who's never done one before!

I couldn't agree more! You really saved us. I didn't know
what we were going to do!
Yeah, sorry about that.

But, you know, I really liked the back-and-forth between the
two of you. You made it a much livelier segment,
Haruka-chan.
Oh, I'm so glad! Thank you very much!

You did a fine job on the gourmet report! Don't you think,
Ichimura-san?

Absolutely. I mean, it was a tiny bit rough here and there,
but considering how we put you on the spot, I'd say you did
great.

It's true. You really saved us. We wouldn't have been able
to do the report without you.

Besides, I really liked the back-and-forth between you two.
You made it a much livelier segment, Haruka-chan.

Thanks to you, we got through this report somehow. We
couldn't have done it without you. Right, Ichimura-san?

Right. I mean, I will have to clean a few places up in
editing, but otherwise I think it'll work out fine.
Sorry about that...

There's nothing for you to apologize for, Haruka-chan. We
really put you on the spot. Besides, if I didn't have this
stomachache⑬
Exactly! Who knows what we would've done!?

Thank you again for doing this for us on such short notice!
Here's the payment I promised.
Thank you, Haruka-chan!
(Oh, crap. I totally lost Yamazaki's trail.)
Shinada-san! What happened out there!?
Oh, uh... Haha, you see...
I did spot Yamazaki, just where you said he might be. But I kind of... you know... lost him?
Arrrgh! So he <Italic>was</Italic> on Kumano Boulevard!
I'll have you know, a photographer from another magazine beat us to it...
Wait, really?
They got photos of Yamazaki and his lady friend just as they were heading into a hotel.
We blew our chance, even though we knew he was on the prowl.
Damn it all... I never should've assigned this to you!
Dang... Yeah, that is a burn. I was hot on the heels of a major scoop.
You think <Italic>you're</Italic> disappointed!? The chief is livid right now! He's practically blowing sparks!
Yeah, but you can't really blame me for this.
This is my first time tailing anybody. It's not like I'm a one-man detective agency.
Yeah, yeah, fine. I'm the idiot for asking you for help in the first place.
But boy, Shinada-san, you really are a one-trick pony. Guess it's nightlfie or nothing for you, huh?
I suppose I learned that the hard way. Goodbye.
(Ouch. Blew my chance to earn some extra cash. Well that sucks...)
Oh, Shinada-san! Am I glad to see you!
Oh, yeah, from the magazine office. Fancy meeting you here. What's up?
There's a big emergency going down. Everyone from the office is scouring the streets⑬it's our chance to score a massive scoop!
A scoop, you say...

Yeah, the pop idol Michiru Yamazaki is here in Kineicho.
He's supposed to be meeting a girl on the side, if you
catch my drift. We're all busting our butts to find him.
Oh. So you're tabloid hunting. Have fun.

Why are you talking like this doesn't mean a thing to you?
Help us, Shinada-san! If you can catch him with that girl
on camera, we'll throw you a decent chunk of change.
Ooh, really!?

You do know Michiru Yamazaki, don't you? He's a pop icon
from Tokyo who's known for his clean and pure relationship
with his beautiful fiancée.

Turns out he's a total scumbag. According to my sources,
he'll sleep with anything that moves. Doesn't matter whether
his targets are married or dating or what. He's a real ass.

Even other celebrities have had their girls stolen away, but
they're afraid to go after him because of his powerhouse
agency. So nobody's spoken out.
And here's the kicker: there are rumors he's been responsible for more than a few abortions. Some of the girls involved even went as far as slashing their wrists...
Whoa... So he's basically chaotic evil, then.

Well, despite all the rumors, he's slippery when it comes to
evading the press. We can never get enough evidence to put
him in his place.
Anyway, we caught wind that Yamazaki's in town. Being that he's away from his home turf, he's bound to be less wary.
We were told he came without his usual posse so he can meet this mystery girl in private. This is our one in a million chance!
Okay, I get the picture. But I don't have a clue what this Yamazaki guy looks like.
I thought you might say that. I have a photo of him right here. Here, memorize this face.
As you can see, he has quite a distinctive appearance. So he shouldn't be hard to spot.
Heheh. Looks like he's got a chicken roosting on his head.

Shinada-san, listen carefully. There's no point in taking
pictures of Yamazaki on his own. If you spot him, tail him
discreetly until he's alone with the other girl.
If you can get shots of them going into a hotel or something, it'll be a huge win for us!
Where could he possibly be, though? Kineicho's a lot of ground to cover.

If we knew that, we wouldn't be pumping all our resources
into finding him. Right now we're assigning each reporter
a certain area in order to blanket the town.
Shinada-san, can you cover Kumano Boulevard for us? That's the one area we're spread thin.
Kumano Boulevard. Roger that.
We're counting on you, Shinada-san. Make it happen!

(Hmm. I don't feel any eyes on me now, but I'm sure someone
was watching me before.)
Sawamura-san! Are you okay!? Where is the paparazzi?
Uda-san... I'm sorry. I lost sight of him.
That's too bad. That must mean he's on to us...
If that's the case, the paparazzi will probably go for another target. Looks like we've lost our trail.
Oh no, really? I'm so sorry I lost him.
No, please don't worry about it. There's nothing that could've been done. We'll take care of it from here.
Now, I must be on my way. Good luck with work. As your supporter, I'll continue to cheer you on.

(Maybe he realized I was looking for him when I started
walking.)
(Did I lose him again? Where is he?)

(There's that funny feeling again! He's definitely watching
me!)
(I have to find him, and fast!)

<Color:255,200,200,255>you're on to him and run away.<Color:Default>

(Did I lose him? Where is he?)
(I have to find him fast!)
(Hm? I'm getting this funny feeling I'm being watched.)

(There it is again! That funny feeling...  Someone is
watching me!)
(The paparazzo must be somewhere nearby.)
You got 3,300 experience points.
Hello, Haruka? It's Yamaura. Ya got a sec?
Do the names Watami and Watamin-chi ring a bell?

Mhm. They're restaurants, right? I'm actually standing in
front of Watami right now.
Oh, you are? Perfect!
Hm? Why's that?
Hang on, lemme back up a bit.

Watami is a Japanese casual restaurant, and Watamin-chi is a
charcoal grill restaurant.

They're both part of the Watami Group, and both are looking
for a new poster girl right now.
A poster girl...
And you want me to apply?

What, you think I'm just sittin' on my hands over here? I
sent in your application a while ago.

Matter of fact, I just got a response from them, sayin' ya
passed the first stage.
Really!? I did!?

The next stage of the audition process is an interview, so
I'll need to fill ya in on that.
Can ya come by the agency when ya get a minute?
Yes, of course! Thank you, Yamaura-san!

By the way, ya might wanna check Watami out before the
interview.
I mean, you're right there, so that works out perfectly.
You want me to go in all by myself?

Yeah, I guess you're right. Ya might feel kind of weird
goin' in alone. All right, never mind.
I'll be waiting at the agency office. See ya soon, kid.
Hey, Haruka-chan!
Asuka-chan!

Thank you so much again for coming with me to my event. You
spent all that time with me even though you're so busy. It
really meant a lot.
